audit.selection: Combined fallout: consistent reported totals minus identified turbidites; incomplete cores are lower bounds; conflicting rows excluded; identical colocated records counted once.
preserved_semantics: Fit a single total-fallout field over all fans; no individual fan volumes are fitted or added.
Subtract numeric identified turbidite thickness; a blank flow cell means none identified in this compilation, not independently proved absence.
Incomplete cores contribute lower bounds from recovered Plinian plus co-ignimbrite material; limits are not exact observations.
Unpartitioned numeric totals remain totals; blank component cells are not assigned fabricated phase thicknesses.
Map IDs 83 and 85 conflict internally; keep separate component-sum and total-column sensitivity cases.
Map IDs 88 and 89 share exact coordinates/thickness; one location constraint, with both source records retained.
Map ID 24 (POS513-41) is 32 cm in the workbook, while Supplementary Note 1 describes a 66 cm sequence; preserve the workbook, test omission.
Black Sea 0.1 cm entries are used as published nominal thicknesses; original publications were not independently re-audited.
2021 PANGAEA catalogue is a cross-check, not extra observations or an override of the 2023 revised data.

Rectangle-based samples and intervals apply only to the regional diagnostic, never to global volume.
Legacy positive values are accepted as measurements unless flagged Pseudo; historical trace/absence encodings need provenance review.
More than half of expected global fallout lies farther from the source than every observation; global volume is strongly extrapolation-dependent.

Experimental ensemble: weights and new-observation discrepancy are fitted from spatial holdouts; only outer validation assesses their performance. No coverage guarantee. Discrepancy does not widen latent maps or volume intervals.
Selected trend touches its decay constraint; extrapolated decay is weakly identified.
Doubling domain widths raises expected volume by more than 20%; distal volume is unresolved.
Contours [0.1] cm extend beyond the reporting extent; no closure or area is fabricated for them.
All volume estimates are bulk deposit volumes; no deposit-density conversion to DRE is applied by this workflow.
